text.zh: 作品以未来中国为背景组织科技、教育与社会想象，是中国早期科幻和技术乌托邦叙事的重要节点。它与 AI 的关系主要体现在对技术塑造社会的想象，而非具体机器智能。
text.en: Set in a future China, the work organizes visions of technology, education and society. Its relevance to AI lies mainly in imagining technology as a force shaping society, rather than in depicting machine intelligence itself.
